label: [Post-COVID postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome: Documentation of a hyperadrenergic phenotype by comprehensive autonomic testing].
summary: Postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome (POTS) is a form of dysautonomia characterized by an excessive increase in heart rate upon standing, in the absence of orthostatic hypotension. Post-infectious forms, particularly following SARS-CoV-2 infection, have been increasingly reported. We report the case of a 34-year-old woman presenting with persistent palpitations, marked fatigue, and orthostatic intolerance that developed two weeks after a mild COVID-19 infection.
